testable.instructions: `item.text` is one requirement record as JSON. Does every MUST and MUST NOT statement in it name an outcome an observer can check as pass or fail?

criteria.yes: Each statement names a result that a test, inspection or command can confirm or refute.
criteria.no: At least one statement states an aim or quality with no result that could be checked.
criteria.unclear: The statements are too vague to tell what would be checked.

atomic.instructions: `item.text` is one requirement record as JSON. Does each MUST and MUST NOT statement impose exactly one constraint?

criteria.yes: Every statement asks for one thing.
criteria.no: At least one statement joins two or more independent obligations.
criteria.unclear: It is not possible to tell how many obligations a statement holds.

defined.instructions: `item.text` is one requirement record as JSON. Is every term in the statements either common usage or defined in the record or in a record it names?

criteria.yes: A reader can understand every term without guessing.
criteria.no: A statement relies on a term that is neither common nor defined.
criteria.unclear: Some term may or may not need a definition.

criteria.instructions: `item.text` is one requirement record as JSON. Do its acceptance criteria test what its statements require, and nothing the statements do not require?

criteria.yes: Each criterion checks a stated obligation, and each obligation has a criterion.
criteria.no: A statement has no criterion, or a criterion checks something no statement requires.
criteria.unclear: The criteria are too vague to match against the statements.

rationale.instructions: `item.text` is one requirement record as JSON. Does its rationale say why the requirement exists?

criteria.yes: The rationale names the problem or need the requirement answers.
criteria.no: The rationale is missing in substance or only restates the requirement.
criteria.unclear: The rationale hints at a reason without stating it.

testable.reason: A statement has no observable pass or fail outcome.

atomic.reason: A statement holds more than one constraint.

defined.reason: A statement uses an undefined term.

criteria.reason: The acceptance criteria do not match the statements.

criteria-unclear.reason: Jev could not match the acceptance criteria to the statements.

rationale.reason: The rationale does not say why the requirement exists.

pass.reason: Every question in the path passed.
